recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food preparation, low-quality ingredients, or issues with recipe execution.
recommendations.action: Implement a standardized recipe and portion control system, conduct daily taste tests, and source higher-quality ingredients. Provide refresher training for kitchen staff on preparation techniques.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant improvement in food consistency and taste, leading to higher customer satisfaction and repeat business.

recommendations.issue: Perceived high prices relative to food quality/portion size or local market, or lack of clear value proposition.
recommendations.action: Conduct a competitive pricing analysis. Consider adjusting prices, increasing portion sizes, or introducing value-driven specials/combo meals. Clearly communicate the value proposition of dishes.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced perception of value, potentially increasing sales volume and customer loyalty.

recommendations.issue: Lack of proper staff training, insufficient staffing leading to stress, or poor management oversight.
recommendations.action: Implement comprehensive customer service training for all front-of-house staff, focusing on attitude, attentiveness, and problem-solving. Review staffing levels during peak hours and improve management supervision.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved customer experience, leading to better reviews and a more positive restaurant atmosphere.

recommendations.issue: Outdated decor, poor lighting, uncomfortable seating, or excessive noise levels.
recommendations.action: Conduct an audit of the dining area. Prioritize improvements such as updating decor, optimizing lighting, replacing uncomfortable seating, and implementing sound-dampening solutions.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more inviting and comfortable dining environment, enhancing the overall customer experience.

recommendations.issue: General operational inefficiencies, lack of attention to detail, or specific recurring minor issues.
recommendations.action: Implement a daily operational checklist for all areas (kitchen, front-of-house, restrooms) to ensure consistency and attention to detail. Encourage staff to report minor issues promptly for resolution.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduction in minor complaints and a more polished, efficient operation.

recommendations.issue: Understaffing during peak hours, inefficient order processing, or kitchen delays.
recommendations.action: Analyze peak hour traffic and adjust staffing schedules accordingly. Streamline order taking and kitchen communication processes. Consider implementing a reservation system or a digital waitlist.
recommendations.expected_impact: Shorter wait times, leading to improved customer satisfaction and reduced customer frustration.
